comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: partnership box 1 12,000 joins income (60,250); box 14A 12,000 drives SE tax 1,696 = 15.3% of 92.35%, whose deductible half (848) sets AGI 59,402; income tax 5,003 = table(43,675 midpoint); total tax 6,699; withholding 6,000 < tax so overpayment is 0. No QBI on a plain box 1 at this pin (the qualified-PTP amount is the only K-1 QBI input, unasked). Schedule SE lines 10 and 11 are each rounded to whole dollars before line 12 adds them (1,374 + 321 = 1,695), so line 24 is 6,698.00, 1.00 below the 076 figure.
